name: mp-port-map-unanswered
title: The host's router mapping line in the lobby when no router answers: under way, then no answer
capture_policy: The routers are loopback fakes started beside the run (tools/net_port_map_fake.py), so no packet reaches a real router; every runner seeds NetworkPortMapEnable = 0 and only this scene's host turns the mapping on by its argv. The router's answer is read from the line the host sees beside the game port in Advanced - Connection.

checklist.what: Right after the lobby opens, the router line says the mapping is under way.
events: assert_label LabelHostNetPortHint "Mapping the port\.\.\." text=".*Mapping the port\.\.\." PASS

checklist.what: With no router answering, the line says so in the player's words.
events: assert_label LabelHostNetPortHint "No router mapping \(no method answered\)" text=".*No router mapping \(no method answered\)" PASS
